relationship.excerpt: Public trade record names THD as buyer, Guangdong Shunshun as supplier, and laminated film for SUNTA PLUS fruit jelly.

strategy.differentiation_angle: nearby supply, laminate structure review, and stable repeat-production control
strategy.first_contact_goal: confirm current laminate structure, roll dimensions, and annual consumption
questions: What laminate structure and total thickness are currently used?
What are the roll width, repeat length, core size, and annual consumption?
risks: The public trade relationship may not represent the current or exclusive supply arrangement.

strategy.entry_product: fruit ingredient and processed-fruit flexible formats
strategy.differentiation_angle: format review for tropical-fruit processing and export handling
strategy.first_contact_goal: identify packed product lines, filling conditions, and export format demand
questions: Which processed-fruit products are packed in flexible formats?
What filling temperature, shelf-life, and export transport requirements apply?
risks: The public product page does not establish the current supplier or exact flexible format.

strategy.entry_product: fruit puree, juice, and dried-product flexible formats
strategy.differentiation_angle: separate structure recommendations by liquid, puree, and dried-product barrier needs
strategy.first_contact_goal: confirm which product family has recurring flexible-format demand and its annual volume
questions: Which product family currently uses pouches or roll film?
What are the pack size, process conditions, shelf-life, and annual volume?
risks: The official site indicates product breadth but not the current supplier, structure, or purchase volume.
